meta.title: FAQ — NestSelf
meta.description: Answers to the most common questions about NestSelf — for employers and employees.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.lead: Everything you need to know about NestSelf, whether you are an employer exploring the programme or an employee looking for support.

items.question: What is NestSelf?
items.answer: NestSelf is an employee wellbeing programme that gives your people confidential access to licensed psychologists, legal professionals and financial advisors — plus self-assessments, webinars and a resource library.

items.question: What services are included?
items.answer: Depending on your plan: therapy and counselling, legal consultation, financial guidance, webinars, a resource library, self-assessment tools, manager support resources and family coverage.

items.question: How does it differ from a traditional EAP?
items.answer: Traditional EAPs often limit sessions and cover only psychological support. NestSelf includes legal and financial guidance, a self-service library, manager tools and anonymised workforce insights — all in one benefit.

items.question: Who is covered — only employees, or family members too?
items.answer: That depends on your plan. Where your plan includes family members, partners and children access the same services at no extra cost.

items.question: How do employees access the service?
items.answer: Employees receive a private link or access code during the launch. They create a personal account and can browse resources, take check-ins or book sessions immediately.

items.question: What data does the employer see?
items.answer: You see anonymised, aggregated wellbeing trends for groups of 10 or more. You never see who used the service, what was discussed or individual assessment results.

items.question: How is confidentiality protected?
items.answer: All professionals are bound by professional secrecy. We sign a data processing agreement, comply with GDPR and local data protection law, and never share individual-level data with the employer.

items.question: How quickly can we launch?
items.answer: From signed agreement to employee access in two to four weeks, depending on the size of your organisation and the number of languages.

items.question: What languages are supported?
items.answer: Sessions and resources are available in Serbian, Hungarian and English. Communications materials are prepared in your chosen languages.

items.question: What credentials do your professionals have?
items.answer: Our network includes licensed psychologists, qualified psychotherapists, legal professionals and certified financial advisors. Every professional's credentials are verified before they join.

items.question: How do you measure outcomes?
items.answer: We track anonymised, aggregated participation and satisfaction trends. We are working toward publishing outcome data; until then, we rely on validated instruments and professional standards.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Plans are priced per eligible employee per month. Your quote is based on headcount, countries and plan. Request a demo and we will prepare a quote for you.

items.question: What is NestSelf?
items.answer: NestSelf is a wellbeing benefit your employer provides. It gives you confidential access to licensed psychologists, legal professionals, financial advisors, self-assessments, webinars and a resource library.

items.question: Is it really free for me?
items.answer: Free for you where your employer covers it. Your coverage is shown before you confirm anything.

items.question: Does my employer know I use it?
items.answer: No. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR sees only anonymised data for groups of 10 or more.

items.question: What can I use it for?
items.answer: Therapy and counselling, legal consultation, financial guidance, wellbeing check-ins, webinars and a resource library — depending on your employer's plan.

items.question: Can my family use it?
items.answer: Where your employer's plan includes family members, your partner and children access the same services at no extra cost.

items.question: How do I book a session?
items.answer: Log in to your NestSelf workspace, choose the type of support you need and pick a time that works for you.

items.question: What if I need help right now?
items.answer: If you are in immediate danger, call the emergency number now: 112 (Serbia and Hungary). For an ambulance: 194 (Serbia) or 104 (Hungary).

items.question: Are the professionals licensed?
items.answer: Yes. Our network includes licensed psychologists, qualified psychotherapists, legal professionals and certified financial advisors.

items.question: Can I choose my therapist?
items.answer: Yes. You can browse available professionals, see their areas of expertise and languages, and choose the one that feels right for you.

items.question: How do the self-assessment tools work?
items.answer: Short, validated questionnaires help you understand your wellbeing and find the right support. They are not a diagnosis — they are a starting point.

items.question: Is it available in my language?
items.answer: Sessions and resources are available in Serbian, Hungarian and English.

items.question: What happens to my data?
items.answer: Your data is processed under GDPR and local data protection law. Professionals are bound by professional secrecy. Your employer never sees individual data.

cta.body: Get in touch and we will be happy to help.
